name: Joma
verdict: Joma is a Spanish sportswear brand founded in 1965 and still run as a family enterprise (Joma Sport, S.A.). No state owner identified. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Kit supplier (technical sponsor) to Getafe since 2004, per Score and Change's 2026/27 La Liga overview; also kits Fiorentina and Levante. Private Spanish family company; no state owner appears anywhere in available material.
